text:
maya: Dropped a new lightweight onboarding strip prototype at the preview link. Objective: surface a single primary task (create API key) and one suggested sample project. Looking for quick UX + accessibility sanity checks. :mag:

arjun: Checked on desktop. I like the single-sample approach. Concern: the sample thumbnail clickable area is tiny right now (only the image). Make the whole card clickable and show a hover affordance.

tess: Copy suggestion: headline currently reads 'Welcome to Redwood' 1 too generic. Propose 'Launch your first model' and subcopy: 'Create an API key or run a curated sample in seconds.' Keeps it outcome-oriented.

jin: Accessibility notes: expand/collapse control needs `aria-expanded` and the strip should use `role="region"` with `aria-labelledby` for the title. Also, when the sample card gains focus, announce: 'Sample: Sentiment demo, includes prompts and config'. Use `aria-live="polite"` for those transient announcements.

nora: Visual/a11y: contrast on the secondary link (ghost) is borderline at 4.0:1. Recommend solid text or higher weight to reach 4.5:1. Also keyboard focus: pressed state uses box-shadow only; add a visible outline fallback.

maya: Good. UX question: If a user dismisses the strip, do we hide for 12h, 24h, or until they complete onboarding? Thoughts?

arjun: I vote 24h by default. But for new accounts (<=3 days) persist dismiss state server-side until they complete an onboarding action. For guests, localStorage 24h.

tess: Behaviour edge: users on small screens may accidentally swipe it away. Make the dismiss control a small 'x' button with accessible label 'Dismiss onboarding strip' rather than relying on swipe gestures.

jin: Technical: the strip currently traps focus in the expanded view because it uses `inert` incorrectly. I'll remove inert and implement focus management that keeps tab order linear. Add `Escape` to collapse and return focus to the strip trigger.

nora: Motion: if we animate the strip sliding in, respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and default to fade-in. Also provide a pause control for animated GIF previews on templates.

arjun: A/B idea: variant A (single-sample + create-key primary) vs variant B (two-sample carousel + create-key). Hypothesis: fewer choices => higher key creation rate. We'll run for 2 weeks.

maya: Measurement: record `onboard.strip_view`, `onboard.strip_dismiss`, `onboard.create_key_click`, `onboard.sample_launch`. Payload: variant, user_id (hashed), step. Keep only necessary fields. Tess, can you draft the telemetry microcopy (one-liner about anonymous events)?

tess: Yup 1 will add: 'We collect anonymized usage events to improve onboarding. Manage in Settings.' small link under the strip.

jin: I'll push keyboard/focus fixes and aria attributes to branch `onboard/strip-a11y` today. Also will add live region announcements for sample focus.

arjun: Deploy preview -> https://preview.redwood-inference/internal/onboard-strip/1976543210 (build 2026-03-23-110). Please test keyboard, mobile, and verify dismiss behavior for signed-in vs guest flows.

maya: Action list: jin -> accessibility + focus behavior; arjun -> dismiss logic + experiment flag `onboard.strip_variant`; tess -> copy + telemetry hint; nora -> contrast + focus ring design. We'll reconvene after the AXE pass. :thumbsup:
